answer: nebula holds one global auction of a decaying pool of seats each epoch; a gale holds identity only by winning a seat, and every seat expires at epoch end. Winners burn their bid of timber, so every additional gale must outbid a deeper incumbent: the kth added gale pays the kth incumbent's ask, and that ask rises with each seat taken. Seats are unique, cannot be split or sublet. The bill is timber burned per seat per epoch in nebula. It breaks if bids are refunded, seats trade off-registry, or capacity is minted outside the auction.
